skill_name: Prepare a presentation about the sun.
workflow: I am going to present a brief overview of the sun.  The sun is the star at the center of our solar system, it is a large, gaseous body made up of mostly hydrogen and helium. It is approximately 93 million miles from Earth and radiates energy in the form of light and heat. The sun is responsible for the Earth's climate and weather patterns, as well as providing energy for life on Earth.
